title: More young people unemployed worldwide amid looming AI risks, UN labour agency says
description: Global youth unemployment increased in 2025, reversing pandemic recovery trends. Young people worldwide now face a worsening job market and fewer opportunities. Artificial intelligence poses further risks to young people's employment prospects.
